title: Provider-neutral AWG oracle discussion admission bridge

binding.worktree_digest: sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters

observations.rule: Sequences, observation identifiers, and evidence digests are single-use and ordered.

discussion_context.uncertainty: One enumerated level and one to four unique enumerated factors
discussion_context.alternatives: One to four opaque ALT identifiers with unique evidence digests and confidence scores from 0 through 100
discussion_context.confidence: One enumerated level and an integer score from 0 through 100
discussion_context.rule: These fields describe bounded context only; they do not select, rank, accept, reject, or resolve an alternative.

projection.rule: AWG alone decides whether a discussion is admitted and what guidance or decision follows.

privacy.allowed: Opaque identifiers, enumerations, bounded integers, revisions, and SHA-256 digests only

failure_semantics.side_effects: The model and checker perform no network, provider, process, LLM, Coordinator, AWG, UI, Git, or durable-state operation.

limitations: A valid envelope proves only deterministic structural consistency of supplied observations.
Confidence, uncertainty, and alternatives are not an oracle decision or evidence truth.
The checker does not submit an admission request or consult AWG.
